taylor-finance: Heads-up — Nora Labs invoice INV-9421 (due 2025-04-02) has three card declines and failed ACH microdeposits (amounts mismatch). Customer asked for wire instructions and wants us to waive the $45 late fee if they wire within 72h.

sam-cs: On a call with them now. They say Plaid returned "account type mismatch". They're ready to wire today if we provide bank details.

jordan-ops: Do we still have a tokenized card? How many automatic retries ran?

taylor-finance: Card token exists; system attempted 3 retries (policy cap). We paused further automated retries.

stripe-bot: Payment retry attempts exhausted for customer:nora-labs (INV-9421). No further automatic retries scheduled.

sam-cs: Customer sent redacted wire info and will include INV-9421 in reference. They also asked we try one manual card charge if they email authorization.

monica-legal: Legal okay with a one-time waiver + manual charge option under conditions: (1) signed PO or explicit authorization email from billing contact, (2) copy of wire receipt on payment, (3) standard KYC/AML checks clear. Cannot skip KYC.

taylor-finance: Agreed. Process: pause auto retries (done), CS to obtain PO and timestamped authorization, legal to confirm, finance to allow a single manual attempt OR accept wire and mark PAID on cleared funds. Will waive late fee if wire arrives within 72h and conditions met.

jordan-ops: I'll draft the manual-charge authorization template and add audit checklist (amount, timestamp, billing contact, invoice id). One manual attempt only.

sam-cs: Sending PO + billing contact email to finance/legal now (cc'd). Customer confirmed they'll initiate wire if waiver approved.

stripe-bot: Manual payment attempts allowed only after explicit customer authorization is recorded.

monica-legal: Received PO. Quick sign-off pending KYC checks; should be done within the hour unless we hit a flag.

taylor-finance: Thanks. Action items: 1) Sam: collect PO + authorization email. 2) Jordan: prepare template. 3) Monica: legal review. 4) Taylor: pause retries / set SLA 72h. Closing loop after receipt of proof of payment. :bank:
